title: Internal Combustion Engine Engineer
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As a Internal Combustion Engine Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join a new team within Propulsion focused on two-stroke combustion engines for our UAV platforms. Working alongside an engine design partner, the team will take in a high-performance engine design and carry it through prototyping, testing and series production. You will work hands-on along this chain. Responsibilities Design & Development Learn an existing two-stroke engine design inside out and build in-house expertise alongside our engine partner. Contribute to engine specifications and design changes, balancing performance, reliability and ease of manufacturing. Integrate the sensors and actuators needed to monitor and control the engine. Prototyping & Testing Assemble engine prototypes and run them on test benches developed by the team. Measure real-world performance and check it against design calculations. Design, build and improve test benches and instrumentation to support engine validation. Support endurance and flight test campaigns, analyze results and drive design improvements. Industrialization & Integration Work with Industrialization engineers to keep designs simple to produce at scale. Prepare production in-house or with manufacturing partners, including assembly processes and documentation. Work with the Aerodynamics team to solve integration challenges between the engine and the airframe. Candidate Requirements Hands-on experience with two-stroke piston combustion engines, in design, testing, manufacturing or operation. Strong mechanical engineering foundation, including stress, vibration, bearings and lubrication. Good command of sensors and embedded electronics, including interfacing sensors such as pressure and temperature sensors, and actuators. Experience with combustion, thermodynamic cycles or thermal management and cooling is a plus. Experience from any industry using small combustion engines is welcome: UAVs, motorsport, power tools, outdoor equipment and similar. Team player who enjoys working closely with external partners and learning fast from experienced engineers. Fluency in English required; French is a strong plus. 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
